description_en: Queries the number of active users of an application within a specified time range, that is, the number of user terminals that engaged in communication
description_zh: 查询应用在一段时间内的活跃用户数，即发生通信的用户终端数
kebab_example: aliyun rtc describe-rtc-user-cnt-data --start-time 2018-01-29T00:00:00Z --end-time 2018-01-29T01:00:00Z --app-id yourAppId --service-area CN --interval 3600 --region cn-hangzhou
name: DescribeRtcUserCntData

parameters.help_en: The start time of the queried data. The time is displayed in UTC. The format is yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ
parameters.help_zh: 查询数据起始时间，UTC格式，格式为yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ
parameters.name: start_time

parameters.help_en:
The end time of the queried data. The time is displayed in UTC. The format is yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ.

The end time must be later than the start time
parameters.help_zh:
查询数据结束时间，UTC格式，格式为yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ。

结束时间需大于起始时间
parameters.name: end_time

parameters.help_en:
The application ID. You can specify only one ID.

By default, all application IDs are queried.
parameters.help_zh:
应用ID，仅支持传单个ID。

默认查询所有应用ID。
parameters.name: app_id

parameters.help_en: The service area. CN: China (default value)
parameters.name: service_area

parameters.help_en:
The time granularity at which the data is queried. Unit: seconds.

Valid values: 3600 (one hour) or 86400 (one day). Default value: 3600.
parameters.help_zh:
查询数据时间粒度，单位：秒。

取值为3600（1小时） 或86400（1天），默认为3600。
parameters.name: interval
